nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in Mongolia
nphi.with: UN BWC Implementation Support Unit; Netherlands MFA; EU
nphi.summary: Adapted RIVM's inventory tool for Mongolia, with workshops on dual-use risk assessment and laboratory auditing.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P53 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity in Central Asia
nphi.with: ISTC (Kazakhstan); VERTIC; Public Health England; Sustainable Criminal Justice Solutions (lead)
nphi.summary: RIVM led the biosecurity training and supported the biosafety training, including hands-on BSL3 work, for national expert teams in seven countries.

nphi.title: China CDC support for setting up a national CDC in Mongolia
nphi.with: Mongolia Ministry of Health; National Center for Communicable Diseases; National Center for Public Health
nphi.summary: After Mongolia's 2024 public health law created a national CDC, a Mongolian delegation studied China CDC's structure and China CDC pledged comprehensive support for establishing the new centre.

nphi.title: SATREPS: control of hepatitis D virus infection in Mongolia
nphi.with: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD); National Pathology Center; Mongolia–Japan Hospital of MNUMS
nphi.summary: Tokushima University SATREPS project with Mongolia's NCCD and partners on control of hepatitis D virus infection.

nphi.title: KDCA–Mongolia laboratory capacity cooperation
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.summary: Building Mongolia's national laboratory capacity, joint training on emerging infectious diseases and provision of quarantine supplies.

nphi.title: KDCA – Mongolia MoH MoU on pandemic preparedness (2024)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.summary: MoU of 15 Feb 2024 on surveillance, lab capacity, a national public health plan and a Mongolian CDC; backed by a 7.2 billion won ODA programme for 2023–2027.

nphi.title: WHO – China CDC training on intelligent public health and open-source epidemic intelligence (EIOS)
nphi.with: World Health Organization (EIOS); delegates from WHO Western Pacific Region member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's Global Public Health Center and WHO hold a yearly training for Western Pacific public health staff on EIOS open-source epidemic intelligence, multi-source surveillance data and rapid risk assessment. The 2025 round, the third,…

nphi.title: China CDC – NCCD Mongolia memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD) Mongolia
nphi.summary: MoU signed in December 2021 on communicable disease surveillance and control, epidemiology research and training, immunization and vaccine research, and lab quality and biosafety, with joint COVID-19 technical exchanges.

nphi.title: China CDC – Mongolia NCCD memorandum of understanding (2021, renewed 2026)
nphi.with: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD) of Mongolia
nphi.summary: MoU first signed in December 2021 and renewed in September 2026 for a new five-year cycle, covering emerging infectious diseases, TB and HIV, workforce development, surveillance IT and emergency response, with plans for FETP and…

nphi.title: IANPHI Asia Regional Network
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Mongolia (vice chair); IEDCR Bangladesh; School of Public Health and Community Medicine Nepal; National Institute of Public Health Japan; National Centre for Disease Control India; National Health Laboratory Myanmar
nphi.summary: Regional network of Asian NPHIs launched in 2016 with China CDC as chair and eight founding members, modelled on the IANPHI Africa network to foster cooperation among Asian institutes; it now counts 28 NPHIs.

nphi.title: CDC–IANPHI partnership for NPHIs
nphi.summary: Since 2011: planning support for Zambia's NPHI (2015), consultation for Burkina Faso's institute (2018), an assessment of Ukraine's Public Health Center (2019) and Staged Development Tool workshops in several countries.

nphi.title: Seminar on Plague Prevention and Control in SCO Countries
nphi.with: Plague and public health experts from SCO member and observer states; Wu Lien-Teh Foundation
nphi.summary: A 2025 Beijing seminar, followed by a Xinjiang–Central Asia technical exchange, to advance technical collaboration and joint plague control mechanisms among SCO countries.

nphi.title: China–Mongolia occupational health exchange
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute for Occupational Health and Poison Control
nphi.summary: A Mongolian Ministry of Health delegation visited NIOHP in January 2025. Both sides agreed to strengthen occupational disease regulation and raise occupational health service standards.

nphi.title: NIRP – Mongolia Ministry of Health exchange on radiation protection
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute for Radiological Protection
nphi.summary: A Mongolian Ministry of Health delegation led by the State Secretary visited China CDC's National Institute for Radiological Protection. The two sides discussed radiation protection systems, standards and medical emergency response to…

nphi.title: BoCO-19 – Corona Global – Burden of COVID-19 population health metrics
nphi.with: National Association of Public Health (Albania); Public Health and Reforms Center (Azerbaijan); IPH FBiH & PHI Republika Srpska (Bosnia and Herzegovina); NCDC Georgia; Al-Farabi Kazakh National University; 'Healthy Future' (Kyrgyzstan); IPH Kosovo; Mongolian National University of Medical Sciences; IPH Montenegro; University of Belgrade (Serbia); Ministry of Health (Türkiye); Ukrainian Institute on Public Health Policy & Public Health Center (Ukraine); Tashkent Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education
nphi.summary: Harmonised burden-of-disease methods for COVID-19 and tested them for outbreak surveillance.

nphi.title: Quadrilateral plague prevention and control cooperation (China–Russia–Mongolia–Kazakhstan)
nphi.with: Russian Research Anti-Plague Institute 'Microbe'; National Center for Zoonotic Disease (Mongolia); National Scientific Center for Especially Dangerous Infections (Kazakhstan)
nphi.summary: China CDC hosted a 2021 webinar with plague institutes from Russia, Mongolia and Kazakhstan to share plague control technologies and work toward a joint cross-border plague control mechanism.

nphi.title: JICA Programme for COVID-19 Crisis Response Emergency Support (Mongolia, NCCD)
nphi.with: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD), Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: Grant aid of up to 883 million yen, executed by Mongolia's NCCD, supplying cold-chain and medical equipment to build a safe COVID-19 vaccination system.

nphi.title: Prevention and Control of Major Non-communicable Diseases and Injuries in Mongolia
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.summary: A completed THL development or expert-cooperation project listed on THL's international consulting pages; the listing gives no further detail.
